verdict.rationale: Semgrep's docs and GitHub note that scanning runs locally by default and code is never uploaded, and the --dry-run flag guarantees no upload to the Semgrep web app, which operationally limits data exposure that could feed model training. However, there is no explicit privacy policy or statement addressing whether data sent to Semgrep's cloud/AI features (e.g., AI-Powered Detection, Semgrep Assistant) is used for AI training, nor any opt-out mechanism specific to AI training. Missing for 10: explicit AI-training data-use policy, opt-out toggle for AI features, and independent confirmation of this guarantee.
